diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate downward trend (a net fall of ~48% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (63 points, ~4% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.166), which favours a robust combination.
